items.guidance: In this Express app, check the main server entry and its route files for an existing lightweight route before adding one. If none exists, register the GET route on the Express app before any passport/auth, rate-limit, or custom-domain/host-check middleware so the load balancer probe on port 3000 reaches it directly.

Inspect server/redis.js to see whether the ioredis Cluster client is always constructed or only when an environment variable enables cluster mode, and trace which runtime modules import it (cache, rate limiting, queues). Report the exact switch and value if one exists, or the import chain if Cluster is mandatory.

Check where bull queues are created and where their process() handlers are registered, and whether that module is imported by the web server started via npm start. Report whether processing runs inside the web process or needs a separate entry point, citing the files.
